description: A25 — 英国开局封闭西西里，非对称双兵链综合练习

intro.popup_en:
Pawn-Chain Direction, Practice 10
A complete review of asymmetric chains: White's c4-d3 chain points toward Black's queenside, while Black's e5-d6-f5 chain points toward White's kingside. Their directions cross, creating a complex structure.
intro.popup:
兵链方向练习10
综合总结！
非对称双兵链：
白链c4-d3→指向黑方后翼
黑链e5-d6-f5→指向白方王翼
两个兵链方向交叉！
最复杂的兵链形式！

outro.popup_en: Summary: b3 prepares queenside development, Nd5 occupies a central key square, f3 drives the bishop away, and e4-d4 expands the center. Nf4 completes White's strong positional setup. Pawn-chain study complete.
outro.popup:
总结：b3后翼布局 → Nd5占中心要点 → f3驱象+e4推进
d4扩展中心 → Nf4！白方位置优势完美体现！
10课兵链方向学习完成！

moves.popup_en: c4 begins the English Opening.
moves.popup: c4英国开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black occupies the center with the e-pawn.
moves.popup: e5！黑方e5占中心

moves.popup_en: e3 forms White's c4-d3-e3 pawn chain, directed toward Black's center in the English Opening.
moves.popup:
e3！白方兵链c4-d3-e3形成
指向黑方中心——英国开局兵链！

moves.popup_en: b3 expands on the queenside and prepares Ba3, supporting the direction of White's pawn chain.
moves.popup: b3！白方后翼扩展，准备Ba3开发，强化兵链方向

moves.popup_en: ...Qc8 retreats the queen to defend the queenside and prepare ...Bg4 to exchange a knight.
moves.popup: Qc8！黑后撤至c8，防守后翼并准备Bg4换马

moves.popup_en: Nd5! White's knight occupies a key central square in the direction of the pawn-chain plan.
moves.popup:
Nd5！白马抢占d5中心要点！
兵链方向上的战略要格

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4 pins White's knight on e2 and adds pressure to the center.
moves.popup: Bg4！黑方象出钉住白马Nge2，施压中心

moves.popup_en: Ba3! The bishop becomes active on a3, pressuring e7 along the diagonal and supporting Nd5.
moves.popup:
Ba3！白方象活跃a3！
对角线施压e7，协助Nd5

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd5 captures White's knight and challenges the outpost.
moves.popup: Nxd5！黑马强夺d5，打破白马据点

moves.popup_en: cxd5! White recaptures and advances the pawn chain. The c4-d5 pawns create a powerful passed pawn.
moves.popup:
cxd5！白方兵链推进！
c4-d5形成強力过路兵

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 retreats the knight, avoiding the pressure on c6.
moves.popup: Ne7！黑马撤守，避开c6格被压

moves.popup_en: Rc1 places the rook on the c-file, coordinating with Ba3 to control lines and diagonals.
moves.popup: Rc1！白车占据c线，与Ba3形成纵横控制

moves.popup_en: ...Qd7 watches the d5-pawn and prepares Black's response.
moves.popup: Qd7！黑后转移，监视d5兵和白方计划

moves.popup_en: f3! White drives away the bishop on g4 and clears the way for e4, completing the preparation for central expansion.
moves.popup:
f3！驱逐Bg4！
为e4推进清路，中心扩张准备完成

moves.popup_en: ...Bh3 exchanges the bishop's route and puts pressure on White's bishop.
moves.popup: Bh3！黑方象换到h3，对白方象施压

moves.popup_en: Bxh3! White exchanges bishops and removes the diagonal pressure.
moves.popup: Bxh3！白方换象，消除对角线威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Qxh3 recaptures, leaving Black's queen active.
moves.popup: Qxh3！黑后夺回，后处于活跃位置

moves.popup_en: e4!! White advances in the center, extending the pawn chain from c4-d3 to e4 and reaching a high level of central control.
moves.popup:
e4！！白方e4中心推进！
兵链扩展到c4-d3-e4，中心控制达到顶峰

moves.popup_en: ...Qd7 retreats passively as White takes the initiative.
moves.popup: Qd7！黑后被动撤回，白方主导局面

moves.popup_en: d4! White expands the center further. The central battle is now fully engaged.
moves.popup:
d4！白方再推d4！
中心扩张到最大，双方决战开始

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 Black has to capture, opening the center.
moves.popup: exd4！黑方不得不吃兵，中心打开

moves.popup_en: Nxd4! White's knight occupies d4 and controls the position.
moves.popup: Nxd4！白马占据d4中心，控制全局

moves.popup_en: ...c6 counterattacks and challenges White's passed pawn on d5.
moves.popup: c6！黑方反击，挑战白方d5过路兵

moves.popup_en: dxc6 captures Black's pawn on c6.
moves.popup: dxc6！白方吃掉c6兵

moves.popup_en: ...bxc6 recaptures, leaving Black with an isolated pawn on c6.
moves.popup: bxc6！黑方兵夺回，但黑阵出现c6孤兵

moves.popup_en: Ne2 begins a strategic reroute, preparing to place the knight on the key f4-square.
moves.popup: Ne2！白马战略调整，准备Nf4跳入关键格

moves.popup_en: ...Rad8 places Black's rook on the d-file and counterpressures d4.
moves.popup: Rad8！黑方车占d线，反压d4方向

moves.popup_en: Nf4! The knight reaches a key outpost, controlling e6, g6, d5, and h5. White's positional advantage is clear, completing the pawn-chain lesson.
moves.popup:
Nf4！白马跳入f4！
控制e6/g6/d5/h5，白方位置优势不可撼动！
10课兵链方向学习完美收官！
